composing_units: 79th Infantry Division; 30th Infantry Division; 2nd Armored Division
current_activity: taking command of 79th, 30th and 2nd Armored Divisions in the Mantes bridgehead
notes: Event date: Breakout-31 p672: at noon on 29 August, as XV Corps headquarters started for an assembly area southeast of Paris, Corlett's XIX Corps took command of the three divisions east of the Seine and moved 2nd Armored Division to the lead. Event definition: XIX Corps takes command of the 79th, 30th and 2nd Armored Divisions, all effective 29 August (the divisions' own rows carry the matching corps entries). Location: the bridgehead area is the corps sector, not the corps command post, which is not located in the sources used (the earlier point was a front-line point at Mantes). Relationship: XIX Corps assigned to First Army.

current_activity: driving from the Albert Canal toward the West Wall
notes: Siegfried-5 p97 maps the XIX Corps drive from the Albert Canal to the West Wall for 10–19 September; on 16 September a task force crossed the Maastricht Canal north of Maastricht (p112).
